caption: The drawing depicts a tall, freestanding grandfather clock against a plain, light beige background. The clock has a wooden case with a rich brown color, featuring marbled and wood grain textures, and is accented with gold trim. The lower section of the clock case has a circular wood grain pattern, while the midsection has an elongated oval inlay outlined in gold. The clock face is set in the upper portion, enclosed in a rectangular glass panel topped with a decorative arched pediment adorned with gold finials. The clock face is white with black Roman numerals, black clock hands, and decorative floral patterns in the corners. Above the clock face is an arch painted with fruit and greenery. The entire structure stands on four short, bracketed feet.
title: Tall Clock
